theorems.name: Submission.p02_es_177ebb5a_ssl_segment_estimates
theorems.statement: ∀ (F H : ℂ → ℂ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (L y₀ : ℝ), 0 ≤ L → 0 < y₀ → ContinuousOn H {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im} → (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → HasDerivAt F (H z) z) → ContinuousOn w (Set.Ici y₀) → (∀ z : ℂ, 0 ≤ z.re → z.re ≤ L → y₀ ≤ z.im → ‖H z‖ ≤ w z.im) → (∀ (x y t : ℝ), 0 ≤ x → x ≤ L → y₀ ≤ y → y ≤ t → ‖F ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) - F ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ ∫ s in y..t, w s) ∧ (∀ (x y : ℝ), 0 ≤ x → x ≤ L → y₀ ≤ y → ‖F ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) - F ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ x * w y)
